text:
maya: Quick heads-up for tonight's change window 01:00-02:00 UTC. Plan: runtime -> v2.3.1 (canary), router -> v1.9.2 (pin after runtime health). Need a short failback plan and final note for release doc.
quentin: Got it. I added a tiny dependency sketch in the PR. Two callouts: header path differences and a kernel batching tweak. Console needs to be able to accept legacy header until we flip the flag.
rachel: Console team will hold the gating flag (ENABLE_HEADER_SPLIT). We can validate parsing of both header formats in prod telemetry but will not flip during canary.
maya: Proposal: 5% canary runtime for 20 minutes. If metrics green, pin router to v1.9.2 and flip ENABLE_HEADER_SPLIT. If runtime shows regressions, do immediate runtime rollback only.
zane: Agreed. I'm prepping a KV fall-back: lower eviction ttl to 30s for the window so warmed prefixes clear fast. Patch + revert commands ready. Note: routing table rebalance may bump p50 for ~2-4m.
deploybot: [deploybot] Preflight started. Checks: infra capacity, model-quant validation, smoke tests. Flagged: quant test failed for mistral-7b-quant. Recommendation: exclude it from canary variants.
quentin: Excluding mistral-7b-quant is fine. We'll add an --exclude-model argument to the canary. Also adding a routing fallback to runtime-legacy if the canary triggers.
liam: Rollback thresholds: sustained error-rate >=1% for 5m OR p95 latency increase >50% for 10m OR router 5xx spike >2x baseline. If any threshold met, trigger runtime rollback and run KV revert.
maya: I'll shepherd rollback. My commands (if needed):
```
/deploy rollback runtime v2.3.1 --to v2.3.0 --reason="canary regression"
kvctl set-ttl --shard all --ttl 5m   # revert to normal
```
zane: Prep commands (ready):
`kvctl set-ttl --shard all --ttl 30s --dry-run`
revert: `kvctl set-ttl --shard all --ttl 5m --dry-run`
I'll be ready to run with ops privileges.
rachel: Console will also ship a quick telemetry flag that annotates which header parser matched (legacy|split) so we can triage faster. I'll push it before T0.
deploybot: [deploybot] Dry-run deploy commands attached:
```
/deploy runtime v2.3.1 --canary=5 --dry-run --exclude-model=mistral-7b-quant
/deploy router v1.9.2 --pin=staged --dry-run
```
quentin: I'll own the dashboard watch (Grafana link in release doc). I'll set alert channels to #oncall and @sre.
maya: Timeline T0=01:00 start runtime canary (5%). T0+10m quick smoke (synth + 1-key journeys). T0+20m in-depth metrics. If green -> pin router and flip ENABLE_HEADER_SPLIT. If any fail -> rollback runtime.
liam: Note: if router pin shows unexpected 5xxs after flip, we should consider rolling back router and re-evaluating console-gate ordering. Router rollback is heavier; prefer runtime rollback first.
zane: Also I recommend enabling the automated fallback route rule for canary: route.fallback=runtime-legacy variant, TTL 60s. That will avoid client-visible failures while we act.
maya: OK I'll update the release notes with: runtime v2.3.1 (kernel batching tweak), temporary exclusion of mistral-7b-quant from canary, ENABLE_HEADER_SPLIT gating, KV TTL fallback plan, and rollback thresholds.
rachel: I'll also add the console flag name and the telemetry annotation note.
quentin: All set on my side. I'll post the final variant IDs in this thread at T-15.
deploybot: [deploybot] Preflight PASS (with model exclusion). Scheduling confirmed.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll be on the thread and ready to post rollback commands if needed. T-minus 15 I'll post a final T-5 checklist. :thumbsup:
